				<post-effect>
					<activate flag="PerfilEconomia"/>
					<condition/>
					<speak-player>Finally we've arrived at our office!</speak-player>
					<condition/>
					<speak-player>As the coordinator of finance and quality you're the person in the NGO that has to take care of all the finances, record all the expenses and ensure the organisation meets all its quality criteria.</speak-player>
					<condition/>
					<speak-player>This is a really important role in the organisation because to do it well you have to make the right decisions about how much to spend and what to purchase, so you'll have to always make the best possible choice, and that's not easy!</speak-player>
					<condition/>
					<speak-player>To start working the first thing you must do is pick up your folder containing all the tasks you have to complete and, of course, your NGO mobile phone.</speak-player>
					<condition/>
				</post-effect>
			</exit>
			<exit destinyX="-2147483648" destinyY="-2147483648" hasInfluenceArea="no" height="220" idTarget="SalaPrincipal" not-effects="no" rectangular="yes" transitionTime="0" transitionType="0" width="220" x="559" y="245">

					<condition/>

				<post-effect>
					<activate flag="PerfilProyectos"/>
					<condition/>
					<speak-player>Finally we've arrived at our office!</speak-player>
					<condition/>
					<speak-player>As project coordinator you're the person in the NGO that has to take care of the design and delivery of all cooperation projects.</speak-player>
					<condition/>
					<speak-player>This is a really important role in the organisation as your responsibilities cover what the NGO does, how it does things and who with, so you'll have to make the right decisions in all situations, or at least try to!</speak-player>
					<condition/>
					<speak-player>To start working the first thing you must do is pick up your folder containing all the tasks you have to complete and, of course, your NGO mobile phone.</speak-player>
					<condition/>

				<post-effect>
					<activate flag="PerfilRelaciones"/>

					<speak-player>Finally we've arrived at our office!</speak-player>
					<condition/>
					<speak-player>As coordinator of institutional relations you're the person that has to manage all the NGO's external relations, decide its corporate image, deliver training and try to encourage people to engage with the organisation.</speak-player>
					<condition/>
					<speak-player>This is a really important role in the organisation because to become a respected NGO you have to determine the right type of interaction it has with the external environment, so it's really vital you make the right choices in every situation. Good luck!</speak-player>
					<condition/>
					<speak-player>To start working the first thing you must do is pick up your folder containing all the tasks you have to complete and, of course, your NGO mobile phone.</speak-player>

		<dialogue-node editor-x="173" editor-y="52" nodeindex="0">
			<speak-char idTarget="Alumno">Hey, it's good to see you. I'm so pleased you've arrived... we thought you weren't coming!</speak-char>
			<condition/>
			<child nodeindex="1"/>
		</dialogue-node>
		<option-node editor-x="168" editor-y="170" nodeindex="1" x="10" y="480">
			<speak-player>Say hello and begin the training lecture</speak-player>
			<condition/>

			<speak-player>Apologise and leave the room</speak-player>
			<condition/>

		<dialogue-node editor-x="94" editor-y="268" nodeindex="2">
			<speak-player>Hello everyone, well I can see you are all waiting patiently so let's make a start.</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>Today we're going to talk about a couple of key concepts.</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>If you're going to work effectively in a voluntary organisation it's vital you know how to get organised, both as an individual and with others. So, the first two issues we're going to cover are the importance of PLANNING and TEAMWORK.</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>Proper PLANNING enables us to allocate the time and resources we need to achieve objectives we have set, taking into account the relevant context.</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>As individuals dedicated to working for voluntary organisations we'll need to carry out projects, set objectives to work towards puposefully and using specific resources.</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>As for TEAMWORK we will need to work in a coordinated way with other volunteers.</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>The important thing is to be able to share the responsibilities reasonably and encourage useful and effective dialogue.</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>If everyone involved commits themselves, supports one another and we work in the same direction, then we can achieve great results.</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>Has anyone got any questions about what we've been discussing?</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-char idTarget="Alumno">That was really interesting and I think it's all pretty clear.</speak-char>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>Fine, but to check that you've understood everything I'd like you to work in pairs to create a basic concept map of the topics we've covered.</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>In order to do it properly:</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>- You need to reflect on all the key concepts we have covered</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>- The concept map should be in black and white only, no colours</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>- It should have no more than three interlinked layers</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>- In total you should include no more than 10 concepts</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>- It must be well organised and nicely presented</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-player>When you have finished you can leave it on my desk. I'll look through them and we can discuss them tomorrow, OK?</speak-player>
			<condition/>
			<speak-char idTarget="Alumno">Right, let's get started.</speak-char>
			<condition/>
			<child nodeindex="4"/>

				<activate flag="MapaConceptual1Realizado"/>
				<condition/>

				<condition/>
			</effect>
